name: Panorama Block – immerse visitors in 360 degree views
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Let visitors look around in every direction – display immersive 360-degree panoramic images and videos on your site within a few clicks.

Image Panorama Demo (Free) | Video Panorama Demo (Free) | Advanced Panorama Demos (Pro) | Pricing

Why Panorama Block?

Panorama Block is a lightweight 360-degree panorama viewer Gutenberg block that lets you display panoramic images and videos on your website within a few clicks. It supports a variety of panoramic files such as .png, .jpeg, .mp4, and more, with spherical texture projections powered by WebGL/Three.js.

The plugin is very easy to use – anyone can configure the viewer without any technical knowledge. Turn on auto-rotation to keep visitors engaged, set the rotation speed right inside the editor, and decide whether viewers can pan, zoom, and drag the scene themselves.

Free Features

  • Spherical 360° View: Spherical texture projections powered by WebGL/Three.js.
  • Image & Video Support: Panoramic images (PNG, JPEG) and video formats (MP4, WebM).
  • Auto-Rotation: Keeps visitors engaged by panning views automatically.
  • Speed Control: Set custom rotation speed dynamically inside the editor.
  • Toggle Viewer Controls: Show or hide user controls for manual panning, zooming, and dragging.
  • Autoplay, Mute & Loop: Custom playback settings for 360-degree video configurations.
  • Uninstall Data Clean-up: Safe option to delete settings from the database upon deletion.

Pro Version – Panorama Viewer Pro

Looking for advanced features like interactive Virtual Tours with multi-scene support, markers and custom hotspots, Google Street View, and WooCommerce integration? Panorama Viewer Pro includes all features of the free Panorama Block plugin, plus these powerful tools to create immersive experiences.

How to Use Panorama Block – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the Panorama Block plugin.
  2. In the Gutenberg editor, search for Panorama Block and add it to any post or page.
  3. Select your panoramic image or video from the media library.
  4. Configure auto-rotation, speed, viewer controls, and playback settings from the right-side sidebar.
  5. Publish – your 360-degree view is live!

Use Cases

  • Real Estate & Interiors: Let prospects explore rooms and properties in 360 degrees.
  • Travel & Tourism: Showcase destinations and landscapes with immersive panoramas.
  • Hotels & Venues: Present event spaces and facilities from every angle.
  • 360 Video Content: Embed panoramic videos with autoplay, mute, and loop options.

Source Code

You can find the source code, report bugs, and contribute to the development of this plugin on our GitHub repository:
Panorama Block on GitHub

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Panorama Block”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. In the Gutenberg editor, search for Panorama Block and click to add the block.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the Panorama Block plugin (.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, choose the panorama-block.zip file, and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Is Panorama Block free?

Yes, Panorama Block is a free Gutenberg block plugin. A premium version, Panorama Viewer Pro, adds virtual tours, hotspots, Google Street View, and WooCommerce integration.

Which file formats does Panorama Block support?

It supports panoramic images such as PNG and JPEG, and panoramic video formats such as MP4 and WebM.

Can I display 360-degree videos as well as images?

Yes. The block supports both panoramic images and panoramic videos, with autoplay, mute, and loop playback settings.

Can the panorama rotate automatically?

Yes. Auto-rotation is built in, and you can set a custom rotation speed dynamically inside the editor.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar, including viewer controls for panning, zooming, and dragging.

How many times can I reuse the block?

You can use the block an unlimited number of times across posts and pages.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Panorama Block plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.
